persons.name: Pūrṇānanda
persons.evidence: pūrṇānandeti nāmā samalikhad ... śrīpūrṇānandana thavata coyā jula

date.as_written: nepāle saṃvadākhye kunavanavayute śrāvaṇē śuklapakṣe || paṃcamyāṃ vaiśvadeve parighakasahite bhānuputrasya vāre ... saṃvat 991 śrāvaṇamāsayā paṃcami(!) utra(!)bhādranakṣakra(!) parighanayoga(!) śanivāra

notes: The chronogram kunavanava gives 991 (ku = 1, nava = 9, nava = 9). The Nevārī phrase 'thavata coyā jula' indicates that the scribe Pūrṇānanda copied the manuscript for his own use.
